newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motor shares fall to 1997 low.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motor shares fall to 1997 low.

text.p: Shares of Mitsubishi Motors Corp slipped to a new low for the calendar year on Monday, as participants unloaded positions to buy other car makers whose earnings are expected to be more solid, traders said.
The share price briefly dipped to 718 yen, a new low for 1997. At 0528 GMT, the share price was down 19 yen at 720. Its trading volume was 3.423 million shares.

"Some expect Mitsubishi profits for the year to March 1998 will go sideways, and this prompted shifting of positions to Honda Motor Co Ltd and Toyota Motor Corp," said a trader at a foreigner securities house.
